question: Should memory-lancedb autoCapture reject EXTERNAL_UNTRUSTED_CONTENT-wrapped text by default, expose an opt-in captureFilter, or defer this to the broader durable memory provenance/trust design?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the choice changes security defaults, plugin config surface, and compatibility for users who intentionally auto-capture external summaries.

options.title: Reject wrapped external content by default
options.body: Add a memory-lancedb capture guard before shouldCapture so canonical external-content wrappers never auto-persist unless maintainers explicitly add a documented escape hatch.

options.title: Add opt-in captureFilter config
options.body: Implement the reporter's captureFilter shape while preserving current default behavior, trading compatibility for weaker safe defaults.

options.title: Defer to provenance design
options.body: Keep this as part of the broader memory trust/provenance work and leave disable-autoCapture or explicit memory_store as the supported workaround for now.

recommendation.title: Reject wrapped external content by default
recommendation.body: Add a memory-lancedb capture guard before shouldCapture so canonical external-content wrappers never auto-persist unless maintainers explicitly add a documented escape hatch.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest available product/security routing signal for deciding config surface versus safe-default behavior across memory/plugin boundaries.
